preconditions.description: The input head must be a ListNode object.
The input head must not be None.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node.val, int) and 1 <= node.val <= 10**6 for node in iter_linked_list(head))
preconditions.description: All node values in the linked list must be integers between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output root must be a TreeNode object.
The preorder traversal of the BST must match the sorted values of the linked list.
The constructed BST must be balanced.
